source.tokenizer_provenance: Existing ByteLevel BPE trained only on historical WikiText train; no new fitting

split_policy.selection_order: parquet row order, retain full documents until each quota met

token_contract.sampling: single-document contiguous context+1 windows only; require end-start >= context+1

deduplication.exact: global accepted-document normalized NFKC+whitespace sha256, case preserved; first accepted wins
deduplication.near: 5-word casefolded NFKC shingles, blake2b64 hashes, 32 affine uint64 MinHash components / 8 bands of4; candidate Jaccard >= threshold; first accepted wins
deduplication.approximate_limitations: LSH candidate retrieval can miss near duplicates; shingle hashes have finite collision probability; no exhaustive all-pairs audit or semantic deduplication. Entire data preparation sees held-out text only to enforce grouping/dedup; no model fitting or evaluation on holdout.

limitations: Single fixed FineWeb-Edu shard, file-order truncation; not a representative sample of all FineWeb-Edu.
Without a local PSL, last-two-label domain grouping is intentionally coarse (e.g. all co.uk); split token proportions need not be96/2/2.
Documents shorter than min_doc_tokens including EOS are removed; no cross-document packing.
Tokenizer was fitted on historical WikiText training data, so this is a transferred tokenizer, not a newly trained FineWeb tokenizer.

tokenizer.fitting: unchanged historical WikiText train-only tokenizer; no fit on fresh holdout

limitations: Fresh documents/domain groups at a fixed unused tail of the same shard/family; not a new independent corpus family. Row-order stopping, domain exclusion and minimum length condition the distribution.

All four FineWeb rounds and all discovered stored text data ledgers plus raw WikiText/bAbI are covered; no assertion about arbitrary text outside this workspace or latent pretraining of unrelated external models.

Historical abstract numeric/token simulations without document text have no natural document identity. Stored text examples are excluded, but this is not a regeneration/enumeration of every possible synthetic sequence.

MinHash LSH can miss high-Jaccard near duplicates; long-span matches use128-bit hashes and exclude aligned64-word blocks, guaranteeing detection of normalized contiguous127-word reuse within an indexed text, not paraphrases or shorter misaligned spans.
WikiText article reconstruction is a conservative supplementary unit; original rows are also indexed. Same-topic texts and brief boilerplate may remain.
Exactly the first256 prediction targets per accepted document are planned, rather than uniform token sampling across whole documents. All designs/seeds must use identical offsets.

tokenizer.fit_policy: Fixed prior WikiText training tokenizer; no fit/adaptation on this holdout

limitations: Fresh documents and conservative domains from the same FineWeb-Edu family, not an independent corpus or language.
Workspace discovery covers the two recorded machines and files under data directories; it cannot establish absence from unrelated external corpora.
Domain groups use last two hostname labels without PSL; e.g. co.uk can conservatively merge unrelated registered domains.
Approximate LSH candidates followed by exact Jaccard can miss near duplicates; no semantic decontamination proof.

Historical 64-word blocks use stride64 and candidates every offset: arbitrary 64-word overlap is not guaranteed detected; a matching contiguous span of >=127 normalized word tokens necessarily contains one complete historical block (apart from hash collision assumptions).
One document per domain makes document and domain bootstrap use the same information; these are not independent robustness checks.
Fixed source row order and first256targets are prespecified sampling choices; historical short strings under unrecognized keys may not be extracted.

medium_holdout.evaluation_window: first256targets per doc, data evidence order=doc order; downstream actual schedule frozen separately
limitations: Train is byte-for-byte reuse of a previously prepared 512,000,068-token corpus from another study; it is not newly collected data or globally unique linguistic content.
Fresh dev/holdout are source- and domain-excluded from inventoried historical accepted/selection materials and reused train; all remain the same FineWeb-Edu family and frozen tokenizer.
Historical discovery covers recorded Mac and Spark data directories, excluding runs/reports/code/env; it cannot establish absence from unrelated external corpora or unrecorded text.
Conservative last-two-hostname-label grouping may merge unrelated registered domains such as co.uk; invalid/IP URLs are excluded.
32-component MinHash/8 bands of four with exact retrieved-candidate hashed-shingle Jaccard >=0.85 is an approximate filter, not exhaustive semantic deduplication.

Historical/accepted 64-normalized-word blocks are indexed at stride64 and candidate blocks queried at every offset; >=127-word contiguous overlap is detected apart from hash collisions, but arbitrary 64-word/short/semantic overlap need not be.
One document per new domain globally makes document and domain bootstrap share the same information; they are not independent evidence.
New evaluation uses only each document's first256 targets; data arrays record document order, while training/evaluation plans must freeze their actual (possibly permuted) schedule.
